profile.headline: Embedded SWE @ Boeing
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience across the full software development lifecycle working in the aerospace industry. Skilled in real-time hardware-in-the-loop and simulation development, test automation and hardware/software integration. Proficient in C/C++, Python, and integrating software with hardware test environments. B.S. in Computational Mathematics from UCF.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman, I developed software supporting complex simulations and hardware systems, combining applied mathematics with full-stack and systems-level engineering.
	•	Developed multithreaded and parallelized applications for high-performance, real-time processing.
	•	Built and maintained C++ DLLs to modularize functionality and support integration across multiple tools.
	•	Created static and dynamic 1553 bus monitoring tools for real-time analysis and diagnostics.
	•	Designed UI applications to visualize hardware communication and provide integration teams with real-time insights.
	•	Authored technical documentation, requirements, and test procedures.
	•	Collaborated with hardware and systems engineers to ensure accurate hardware–software interaction.
	•	Supported system-level integration to ensure software worked seamlessly with hardware and simulation environments.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Business Analyst
positions.description:
As a Quality Assurance Business Analyst Intern, my role was vital in bridging the gap between business goals and IT products within the DevOps team. I utilized my skills to ensure that the software products aligned with industry quality standards and met the desired business outcomes.

One of my key responsibilities was to maintain and document a comprehensive working knowledge of industry quality standards. This involved staying updated with the latest industry practices and regulations to ensure that the software development process adhered to the highest quality standards.

I actively participated in the end-to-end testing of software products. This involved thoroughly examining each aspect of the software to identify any potential quality issues or bugs before they could reach production. By conducting rigorous testing, I played a crucial role in identifying and resolving quality issues early in the development lifecycle, which helped in minimizing risks and ensuring a high-quality final product.

Throughout the testing process, I worked closely with developers to efficiently escalate any identified quality issues for remediation. By effectively communicating and collaborating with the development team, we were able to address and resolve issues promptly, ensuring that the software met the required quality standards.

In summary, as a Quality Assurance Business Analyst Intern, my role involved actively contributing to the software development process by ensuring adherence to industry quality standards, conducting comprehensive testing, and collaborating with developers to address and resolve any identified quality issues.
